sourceJobs.prompt: Design UI assets for Tavern Heros, a cozy frontier fantasy pixel-art autobattler. Keep identical rendering language across the pack: deliberate chunky square pixel clusters, crisp dark-warm external silhouette, upper-left lit 3-step ramps, graphic readability at 48px, broad flat faces. Use attached visual reference solely for visual grammar and functional meaning. Explore this particular material language, give it a distinctly new silhouette and surface treatment. On truly transparent canvas; no outlines or shadows outside the individual controls; no gradients, scene, type, letters, numbers, labels, fake lettering, or mockup page. honey-oak tavern joinery, thick dark walnut wood faces with one simple broad grain line, cut square corners and black iron corner straps; pale wheat-gold icons. Shape language of a carved horizontal inn sign; the red deploy plate is painted wood. Exactly FOUR equally sized independent nearly-square icon buttons in precisely 2 columns x 2 rows on a square transparent canvas. Centers at 25%,75% of width and height, broad empty gutters. All four share same button backing, same scale and outline. Distinct large centered pictograms: TOP LEFT a golden coin purse with drawstring, TOP RIGHT two clear thick opposing curved arrows forming a reroll loop, BOTTOM LEFT a captain's war horn with red ribbon, BOTTOM RIGHT an upward gold chevron above a small simple tavern roof. Preserve icon identity and legibility; one complete silhouette per quadrant. No extra things anywhere.

Repaint only the FOUR CENTER SYMBOLS from this Tavern Heros game HUD reference as FREE-STANDING PIXEL OBJECTS on real transparency. Remove the complete backing tile and perimeter decoration from EVERY icon. Exact four symbols, 2x2 evenly spaced layout on square canvas with centers at x25/75 and y25/75. Upper left a compact closed gold coin purse, upper right a matched pair of curved clockwise reroll arrows in a circle, bottom left a simple brass captain's horn with one red cloth wrap, bottom right a single upward chevron directly atop a little blue tiled inn roof. Big unmistakable silhouettes that will be only 30 native pixels tall. Minimal interior marks, 3-value ramp, dark one-pixel object outlines, golden afternoon light, cozy old-school strategy RPG, precisely stepped pixels. Each floats alone with generous transparent gaps and no backing shapes, tiles, frames, panels, borders around icons, shadows, text or digits. Background alpha transparent. Family treatment: honey ochre and dark walnut grain, hand-carved oak

designs.name: 주조소 명판
designs.description: 청회색 철판의 모서리를 짧게 잘라낸 명판입니다.
